about: Regression for the v1.4.7 culling bugs (vanishing prisoners). Load a populated nest, scroll the camera to the bottom, then move cells that are now off-screen (swap floors 0 and 1). Every follower (unit buttons, monsters, tentacles, props) must move with its cell even while off-screen, and every prisoner must keep its unit button. Mutation-tested: re-adding the camera-bounds check in scr_main_end_step makes this fail.

steps.why: unit buttons for loaded prisoners keep appearing for ~60 frames after load
